notes: Small additive Retrain now build. Manager/Admin can record additional instructor-led retraining for any active assignee even when the normal training is still current. Each event records the person, current training/version, instructor, training date, factual reason, optional note, attendance, and whether it counts as the scheduled refresher. Attended retraining requires the employee's own authenticated acknowledgement and a fresh opening of the current training material after the retraining event was created. If Counts as scheduled refresher is Yes, the next due date is recalculated from the retraining delivery date after employee acknowledgement; if No, the existing scheduled due date is unchanged. Absent events are retained as separate audit entries and never reset the schedule. Repeated retraining events remain separate immutable audit records. Existing prerequisite sequencing is checked before retraining is recorded. Supabase migration training_retraining_events_v21061 applied.
